import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Calculate age from birth year (assuming current year as 2023)
current_year = 2023
data['Age'] = current_year - data['Year_Birth']

# Calculate total spending across all product categories
data['TotalSpent'] = data['MntWines'] + data['MntFruits'] + data['MntMeatProducts'] + \
                     data['MntFishProducts'] + data['MntSweetProducts'] + data['MntGoldProds']

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='TotalSpent', hue='Age', size='TotalSpent', 
                palette='viridis', sizes=(100, 500), data=data)
sns.regplot(x='Income', y='TotalSpent', data=data, scatter=False, color='red', 
            line_kws={'label': 'Regression Line'})
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending with Age Correlation')
plt.xlabel('Income')
plt.ylabel('Total Spent')
plt.legend(title='Age')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Calculate age from birth year (assuming current year as 2023)
current_year = 2023
data['Age'] = current_year - data['Year_Birth']

# Calculate total spending across all product categories
data['TotalSpent'] = data['MntWines'] + data['MntFruits'] + data['MntMeatProducts'] + \
                     data['MntFishProducts'] + data['MntSweetProducts'] + data['MntGoldProds']

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='TotalSpent', hue='Age', size='TotalSpent', 
                palette='viridis', sizes=(100, 500), data=data)
sns.regplot(x='Income', y='TotalSpent', data=data, scatter=False, color='red', 
            line_kws={'label': 'Regression Line'})
plt.title('Income vs Total Spending with Age Correlation')
plt.xlabel('Income')
plt.ylabel('Total Spent')
plt.legend(title='Age')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
